title: ISnowiAi
description: ISnowiAi allows players to seamlessly switch between global chat and a private AI-powered conversation using Groq AI. By toggling chat modes, you can interact with an intelligent assistant in complete privacy, hiding your messages from other players until
body:
🔧 *ISnowiAi Plugin*
- *Name:* ISnowiAi
- *Functionality:* Seamlessly toggle AI-powered chat on your Minecraft server using `/ai on` and `/ai off`
- *AI Chat Mode:*
    - Engage with Groq AI directly in-game for queries, games, or help 👀
    - Player chat is hidden from others for focused AI interactions
    - Your chat is sent to Groq AI for responses
- *Normal Chat Mode:*
    - Chat freely with other players 💬
    - No AI interference or message routing
- *Requirements:*
    - Valid Groq AI API key (obtain from Groq website)
    - Spigot or Paper Minecraft server (1.21.1+)
    - Plugin developed in Java using Spigot API
- *Key Features:*
    - Simple command-based toggle between modes
    - Enhanced privacy for AI interactions
    - Easy to integrate, configure, and customize
    - Lightweight design for server performance
- *Use Cases:*
    - AI companions for solo players
    - Moderation assistance
    - Creative brainstorming partner

*Terms & Conditions:*
- ISnowiAi requires acceptance of Groq AI's API terms and Minecraft's ToS
- Use responsibly; not for spamming, abuse, or sharing sensitive data
- Plugin provided "as-is"; ensure server backups and monitor usage 😊
- Permissions and API keys are user's responsibility
